import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from sklearn.tree import DecisionTreeClassifier
from sklearn.svm import SVC
from sklearn.model_selection import cross_validate, train_test_split
from sklearn.metrics import accuracy_score, balanced_accuracy_score, roc_auc_score
from sklearn.pipeline import make_pipeline
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler
from sklearn.impute import SimpleImputer

# 加载数据集
train_data = pd.read_csv('cs-training.csv')
test_data = pd.read_csv('cs-test.csv')
sample_entry = pd.read_csv('sampleEntry.csv')

# 探索性分析和数据预处理
# (a) 类的分布情况（仅针对训练集）
class_counts = train_data['SeriousDlqin2yrs'].value_counts()
plt.bar(class_counts.index, class_counts.values)
plt.xlabel('Class')
plt.ylabel('Count')
plt.title('Class Distribution in Training Set')
plt.xticks([0, 1], ['Non-Default', 'Default'])
plt.show()

# (b) 缺失值检查
missing_values = train_data.isnull().sum()
missing_values = missing_values[missing_values > 0]
plt.bar(missing_values.index, missing_values.values)
plt.xlabel('Feature')
plt.ylabel('Missing Value Count')
plt.title('Missing Values in Features')
plt.xticks(rotation=45)
plt.show()

# (c) 特征的分布情况
for column in train_data.columns[1:]:
    plt.scatter(range(len(train_data)), train_data[column], alpha=0.5)
    plt.xlabel('Index')
    plt.ylabel(column)
    plt.title(f'Distribution of {column}')
    plt.show()

# 模型训练与评估
X = train_data.drop(['SeriousDlqin2yrs'], axis=1)
y = train_data['SeriousDlqin2yrs']
X_train, X_test, y_train, y_test = train_test_split(X, y, test_size=0.3, random_state=42)

# 使用中位数填充缺失值
imputer = SimpleImputer(strategy='median')
X_train_imputed = imputer.fit_transform(X_train)
X_test_imputed = imputer.transform(X_test)

# (a) CART决策树
weight = len(y_train[y_train == 0]) / len(y_train[y_train == 1])
cart_model = DecisionTreeClassifier(class_weight={0: 1, 1: weight})
cart_model.fit(X_train_imputed, y_train)
y_pred_cart = cart_model.predict(X_test_imputed)

# (b) 支持向量机
svm_pipeline = make_pipeline(StandardScaler(), SVC(class_weight='balanced'))
svm_pipeline.fit(X_train_imputed, y_train)
y_pred_svm = svm_pipeline.predict(X_test_imputed)

# (c) 在测试集上评价模型性能
def evaluate(y_true, y_pred, name):
    print(f'{name}:')
    print('Accuracy:', accuracy_score(y_true, y_pred))
    print('Balanced Accuracy:', balanced_accuracy_score(y_true, y_pred))
    print('AUC:', roc_auc_score(y_true, y_pred))
    print()

evaluate(y_test, y_pred_cart, 'CART Decision Tree')
evaluate(y_test, y_pred_svm, 'Support Vector Machine')
